title: BlueBenx Finance operations suspended
description: BlueBenx told customers that BlueBenx Finance operations were being suspended, including withdrawals, redemptions, deposits and transfers. The company attributed the action to an alleged hack, but CYA does not treat that claimed cause as independently established.
notes: The event date follows the customer communication reported by contemporary sources. The alleged hack remains an attributed company claim rather than CYA's failure-cause classification.

title: CVM ordered BlueBenx crypto-linked offerings suspended
description: Brazil's CVM ordered Bluebenx Tecnologia Financeira S.A. and responsible individuals to suspend public offerings of crypto-linked collective investment contracts, including named BlueBenx products, because they lacked authorization for the offering activity.
notes: The stop order is a regulatory event separate from the earlier platform withdrawal freeze. Investigation-stage references to suspected fraud are not used as final findings here.

title: CVM imposed sanctions for unregistered public offering
description: CVM reported a unanimous decision imposing fines on Bluebenx Tecnologia Financeira S.A. and Roberto Cardassi for conducting a public securities offering without the required registration or exemption.
notes: This administrative enforcement outcome does not determine customer recovery or the cause of the August 2022 withdrawal freeze.

title: CVM sanctioned fraudulent securities-market operations and unregistered offering
description: After resuming the judgment, CVM unanimously imposed sanctions on Bluebenx Tecnologia Financeira S.A. for fraudulent securities-market operations and for a public securities offering conducted without registration or exemption.
notes: This is an administrative CVM decision and the sanctions were appealable with suspensive effect. It is not described as a criminal fraud conviction.

title: TIME DeFi Farm subscription closed
description: Hotbit closed subscription to the TIME T+1 DeFi Farm investment product and said remaining positions would be automatically redeemed on 3 February for users to view in their investment accounts on 4 February.
notes: Automatic product redemption into the Hotbit investment account is not treated as proof of successful external withdrawal.

title: Multiple DeFi Farm investment products closed
description: Hotbit closed subscriptions for IOTX, REEF, WOO, BOTTO, OOE, EOS and ALICE T+1 DeFi Farm products and scheduled automatic redemption for remaining positions.
notes: The first-party notice says users could check redeemed balances in their investment accounts after the automatic redemption date.

title: SPS staking investment product closed
description: Hotbit closed subscription to the SPS staking investment product and said the system would automatically redeem remaining positions for users who had not redeemed them themselves.
notes: The support article title says T+8 while the article body says T+28. CYA preserves the product generically as SPS staking investment rather than choosing one inconsistent term label.

title: Hotbit ended centralized-exchange operations
description: Hotbit announced that all CEX operations would cease from 04:00 UTC on 22 May 2023 and asked users to withdraw remaining assets by 04:00 UTC on 21 June.
notes: The withdrawal deadline is not treated as proof that every customer successfully withdrew or that every investment balance was fully repaid.
